snippet.title: Introducing a new enemy to celebrate Super Mario Construct's Desktop Release soon!
snippet.description:
Woohoo, it's almost time for the desktop port of Super Mario Construct! To celebrate such event, we're adding a new enemy to go along!

Strollin' Vibe footage: https://youtu.be/kRjSCrLOY74?si=xTmAehtRxZPJLbci
